modules.module_title: Assemble system formwork for RCC structures

pcs.pc_description: clean the shutter panels before using for shuttering work
check the supporting base prior to erection of system formwork
check and ensure all tools, material, components are available as per requirements
check that fixing of fasteners is as per system used and as per the requirements
apply release agents to sheathing material as per specifications and instructions
place and fix kicker for column, walls and check its position with respect to line, alignment, and necessary grid dimension
position and set out formwork manually or by mechanical means as per instructions/drawing and requirement
use appropriate methods/ tools for levelling of the formwork such as water level pipe, dumpy level, auto level or laser levelling machine
position and provide necessary support to the formwork using props or other appropriate components based on system used
check for block-outs and cast-in services at specified locations
plug all openings and gaps using foam sheet and adhesive tape or other appropriate materials
ensure water tightness of form by providing form sheet or necessary packing material
position and fix props properly and check for plumb, position and spacing as specified or instructed
provide horizontal or vertical construction joints in case of structural element such as beam , column, slab as per standard practices
ensure tightness of tie rods, supports, and bracings
check that line, level, alignment and plumb of the erected formwork is within tolerance limit
check the linear or angular dimensions for accuracy and take necessary corrective measures if required
plan sequence of dismantling procedure as per standard practice and system used
remove bracing and all other supports provided to the formwork sequentially and safely as instructed
remove sheathing material sequentially using proper tools and tackles to avoid damage to structure or sheathing materials
dismantle formwork shutters manually or by mechanical means as per requirement
repair, clean and stack all the formwork materials/ components after dismantling

modules.module_title: Assemble conventional shuttering / formwork for R.C.C structures

pcs.pc_description: clean shutter panels prior to use
check suitability of supporting base prior to erection of conventional formwork
check that all tools, materials, components and fixtures are available as per requirements
identify critical areas of the formwork and perform "Dry-mock up" for them as per the given instructions
apply release agents to sheathing material as per specifications and instruction
apply necessary soldier and walling
position and strike box-outs and bolt boxes, grout checks, level controls, angle fillets and features
use appropriate methods/ tools for levelling the formwork such as water level pipe, dumpy level, auto level or laser levelling machine
position and provide necessary support using runner pieces , timber , props, tie systems appropriately
brace formwork support as per requirements and specifications
ensure water tightness of form by providing form sheet or appropriate packing material
check for proper fixing of tie rods, supports, bracings after erection
plug all openings and gaps using foam sheet and adhesive tape
check erected formwork for line, level, alignment within tolerance limit and provided supports
check the linear and angular dimension for the accuracy and take necessary corrective action if required
plan sequence of dismantling procedure for the conventional formwork as per standard practice
remove bracing and all other supports sequentially and safely as instructed
dismantle formwork shutters manually or by mechanical means as per the requirements
repair, clean and stack all the formwork materials/ components after dismantling
